children: Insurance brokerage's Q3 revenue rose 7.4% yr/yr but missed analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 rose 1.9% but missed analyst expectations
Company's organic revenue grew 1.2% amid challenging rate environment
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or full year in the press release
CUSTOMER WINS - Co said efforts to win more customers helped drive results despite challenging rate environment, per CEO J. Powell Brown
ACQUISITION IMPACT - Addition of 5,000 teammates from Accession enhanced co's capabilities, per CEO
MODEST ORGANIC GROWTH - Organic revenue grew 1.2% and organic revenue with contingents grew 1.5%
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", 16 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the multiline insurance & brokers peer group is "hold"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Brown & Brown Inc is $74.50, about 4.8% above its October 26 closing price of $71.08
The stock recently traded at 15 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
